items.source_en:
We all agreed that to repair the exterior, we'll first need to stop the leaks to get access to the port. 

To handle this, I directed a strike team to focus on finding and patching leaks in the pipe work. For the smaller leaks, we were able to wrap the pipes in tape and epoxy and let it cure. For some of the larger leaks we used a gasket and clamp approach, but I don't have an estimate on how long it'll hold. 

These measures are designed to be short term fixes, but it should buy us enough time to do the exterior hull work. It will be dangerous for whoever goes out there, because of the orbiting debris. The crew is talking about drawing straws, which I agreed was the fairest way. I pray this is the right choice.
